en: Fellas, a couple of great wins tonight.
Casper, I want to start with you.
Before your doubles match, Carlos won
an absolutely epic match out here.
Did that give you guys
a little extra confidence and freedom
to come out here and play well?
Maybe.
I mean, it was nerve-racking watching every
match today.
So sometimes it's almost better to play
than to watch from the sidelines.
And luckily,
we avoided another match tiebreak now
and it was really fun.
A great team effort to get two wins
in this night's session was needed
after two tough losses, so really happy.
And Sasha,
all the guys here are singles players.
I think a lot of amateurs
when they watch doubles, they say,
why aren't you guys serving in volley?
Can you just respond to that?
Why don't you guys serve in volley?
Do you try to play like singles players
or do you try
to play like doubles players out here?
No, we try to play like singles players
because if we would serve in volley,
we would lose very, very quickly.
So there's no point of doing that.
I think we probably hit a little bit
of a bigger forehand
than some doubles guys.
And doubles guys definitely volley better
than us.
So, you know, it's a give and take,
but I'm very happy with the team effort.
I think Carlos kicked it off with, you know,
probably the most important win
of the weekend.
And I'm very happy
that we finished the day off with a win
as well.
